name: Erin Woods
discoveryMethod: First-party English and Canadian French discovery, official Calgary parcel-fabric documentation, and bounded anonymous HTTPS Socrata API inspection.
queryOutcomes: English discovery found the City of Calgary OPF custodian page and public parcel-assessment dataset. French discovery returned the same official English-language Calgary sources and no distinct local French parcel service. The live public endpoint returned three Erin Woods records with CPID and MultiPolygon geometry.

attempts.query: Erin Woods Calgary official parcel cadastral map GIS open data
attempts.outcome: Official Calgary community, OPF, and open-data results found.

attempts.query: site:calgary.ca Erin Woods parcelles cadastrales Calgary données ouvertes
attempts.outcome: Official Calgary OPF and open-data pages found; no separate French-language viewer/API.
Socrata metadata returned schema including multipolygon geometry, cpid, and documented assessment/address fields.
Anonymous sample returned a MultiPolygon record; schema inspection confirmed native geometry response.
Bounded safe-field query returned three Erin Woods MultiPolygon records: CPIDs 100226505, 100226699, and 100226796. Full unchanged geometry retained in the sample file.

sourceAssessment.localCustodian: The City of Calgary Asset Information & Mapping / Open Data service, with OPF documentation explicitly describing Calgary city-limit parcel fabric and Alberta Land Titles-derived inputs.
sourceAssessment.publicService: Public Socrata resource endpoint 4bsw-nn7w; anonymous GET response verified with cpid and multipolygon fields. The official OPF product page separately states the detailed OPF is distributed through City Online.
sourceAssessment.nativeFieldsObserved: cpid (retained as stable native identity), multipolygon (retained as geometry), plus non-retained assessment, address, legal, and account fields.

scopeLimits: The three-feature query is a bounded sample, not a complete Erin Woods export.
The exact WUP point is a locator only; no point-hit inference was used and no coordinate was shifted.
The public assessment dataset documents exclusions and is not equivalent to a complete legal OPF extract.
No owner, address, titleholder, tax, contact, personal, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Research completion does not constitute source integration, adapter admission, or runtime qualification.
uncertainty: Public geometry and CPID identity are verified for three records, but complete community coverage, parcel-type exclusions, current OPF equivalence, and adapter-level qualification remain unresolved.
pointBasis: Immutable WUP queue point; retained exactly and not shifted to seek a parcel hit.
